title: POST /intake/clients/:externalId/proposals request
description: Only an admitted client (on the firm's roster) with no submission on conflict hold may propose; otherwise 409. Proposals never create a profile. adverse_party facts run through the firm's conflict check. Tolerant reader: receivers MUST ignore properties they do not know; additionalProperties is therefore never false in this contract.

client.description: Deprecated and ignored (accepted for backward compatibility): proposals no longer create a profile.
